cases.doctrine_projection: The canonical PM form holds unknown keys in the extras object (design section 2). Relocation into extras is projection behavior (design section 7 slice 2), not a read error; until a projector lands, preservation in place is the conforming reader behavior.

cases.historical_source: A v1 block whose extras dictionary already carries relocated/unlisted data; extras content is preserved byte-for-byte semantically (same JSON value) through parse and re-stamp.

Declared field links carrying an object instead of an array (a producer bug shape). The block parser gates on the version key only, so the block parses; the value is caller data, preserved as written by the stamp path.
cases.doctrine_projection: Type-directed handling (design section 3.2): the mismatched value relocates to extras unchanged, the declared links view defaults to [], and the mismatch is reported - never an error, never a silent coercion. Projection behavior is design section 7 slice 2; no current reader projects, so this case's executable expectation is parse-and-preserve only.

cases.historical_source: A fenced block without the version key is not a versioned Metadata object (doctrine rule 1: version always carried).
pm_meta 2 is newer than every published reader. Readers accept every prior version indefinitely; a version newer than the reader is refused fail-closed, never guessed at.
An ordinary issue body with no pm-metadata markers parses successfully with no block; absence of Metadata is not an error.
